'''Russell Bartlett'''<ref name="dt-9925">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9925 But Daddy Im A Jedi], DeckTech (Russell "Bubo" Bartlett, 27 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9925/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9925/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018130625/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9925/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Bubo''') posted a [[Light]] [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|I Can Save Him]] list on DeckTech in August 2000.
